Exporting The X.509 Provider exports a certificate, a bundle of certificates, a part of a certification path, or a full certification path. The private key of the corresponding export is not included in the export.

Getting or Querying When an application or a Functional Cluster needs a specific certificate, it can either use a configured one (this is provided via the CryptoCertificateInterface ) or can get a certificate via the X.509 Provider mechanism.
